buckets.name: Momentum Investing
buckets.rules: Monthly close at an all-time high after a cup of 2+ years; buy when price crosses that month's high. Stop: weekly close below the 30-week SMA, raised every week until it triggers. Entry needs a daily close above that high on at least 1.5x the 50-day volume, then a buy-stop next session at that day's high + 0.15%; skipped when the stock's industry is in a Weak, Fading or Turning Pulse lane.
buckets.test: NSE 2017-26 alone: 17.3%/yr, worst fall -16.8%. With close confirmation + industry-lane skip (2008-26, shared with Trend 9/21): 20.5%/yr vs 17.9%.

buckets.name: Trend Following 9/21
buckets.rules: Same monthly breakout with a 1-2 year cup. Stop for sizing: EMA 21 (min 4% under the entry); exit when a daily close has EMA 9 below EMA 21 (sell next open). Entry needs a daily close above the highest wick so far, then a buy-stop next session at that day's high + 0.15%; skipped when the industry is in a Weak, Fading or Turning Pulse lane.
buckets.test: NSE 2017-26 alone 10.5%/yr, worst fall -15.6%; with Momentum (60/40, one account) 23.1%/yr, -21.4%.

buckets.name: 9/21 Trend (any stock)
buckets.rules: Daily EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 on a stock in an uptrend; stop = 5-day low (max 12%); exit on Supertrend(10,3) red.
buckets.test: Off: in the full one-account test it adds about 1.7 points a year but deepens the worst fall from -21% to -28% (with Top Bottom: 36.2%, -23.3% vs 33.2%, -15.9%). Alone 20.7%/yr, -22.9%.

buckets.name: Breakout retest
buckets.rules: First return to an old breakout level; stop 1 ATR under it, 3R target, out after 120 days.
buckets.test: Off: +0.2R a trade on average, but as a 10-slot portfolio -1.3%/yr (the trades it can take cluster in falling markets).

buckets.name: Bottom pattern
buckets.rules: Double/triple bottom, tilted W, inverse H&S neckline breakout; stop under the pattern, measured-move target, 120 days.
buckets.test: Off: lagged the average stock in every industry lane (NSE 2017-26) and a random stock in the US/ASX test.

buckets.name: VCP
buckets.rules: Volatility contraction pattern in a Stage 2 uptrend: >= 2 shrinking pullbacks with higher lows, volume drying up; buy-stop above the last pullback's high on 1.4x volume; stop = that pullback's low (max 10%); sell after a daily close below EMA 50.
buckets.test: NSE 2017-26: +4.9% a trade (221 trades, 37% win), robust across rule variants; added to Momentum + Trend it gave 24.2-24.7%/yr vs 23.1% with a similar worst fall and nothing extra in 2022-26, so it is a watch bucket - your call.

buckets.name: Pulse rotation
buckets.rules: Each Friday close: NSE industries in the top 10% by 1-month Pulse AND rotation Leading/Improving; hold the 10 strongest trending stocks of those industries by 3-month return (kept while in the top 20 and the industry stays selected); equal weight (the % you set / 10 a stock); buy and sell at Monday's open. RED traffic light at the Friday close: no basket that week (cash). Safety stop 20% below the buy (not in the test).
buckets.test: NSE 2016-26 (survivors), Monday-open fills, 0.2% a side, RED-light skip: 37.4%/yr, worst fall -23.0%; last 1/2/3/5 years +19.7/+16.7/+40.6/+45.9% (without the skip 34.5% / -35.9%). Trial: starts at 0% - set a small % to trade it.

buckets.name: Flags
buckets.rules: Flag, pennant or rectangle after a 15%+ pole in an uptrend: tight pause (<= 8%), volume drying up, breakout close on 1.5x volume with room >= 0.8 x the pole to the next resistance. Buy next open (within 3% of the breakout close); stop the flag low; sell next open after a daily close below the 21-day EMA.
buckets.test: NSE 2016-26: +3.2% a trade (1,151 trades, PF 1.79); in the New mix (Mom+Cup 40, Flags 20, Pulse 10, gold 10, US 20) since 2017 35.7%/yr with Top Bottom, worst fall -14%. Weak in 2025-26. Starts at 0% - set 20% for the New mix.

buckets.name: Gold
buckets.rules: GOLDBEES held at your % of capital as a hedge, no stop. Topped up when it is more than 15% under the target (buy next open). Never sold by the app.
buckets.test: Gold moves against stocks; 10% gold in the New mix cut the worst fall since 2017 (-14% vs -22.6% for the old mix). Starts at 0% - set 10% for the New mix.

buckets.name: System 1
buckets.test: Off on NSE: below the Nifty in every version tested; a US paper candidate.

buckets.name: Wealth Creation
buckets.rules: ETF Pie funded by a monthly SIP, outside the systems' capital: Nifty 50, Midcap 150, Gold and US Nasdaq 100 ETFs at fixed weights (Equal, Balanced or Aggressive) rebalanced each quarter, or the monthly rotation (best 2 by 3-month return).
buckets.test: 2016-26 monthly, price indices, 0.2% per switch: Equal 25% each 18.3%/yr, worst -15.7%; Balanced 30/20/30/20 17.6%, -14.7%; Aggressive 30/30/10/30 18.4%, -20.2%; rotation 17.7%, -12.8%; Nifty 50 11.6%, -29.3%.

buckets.name: Top Bottom
buckets.rules: Bank Nifty futures on the Top Bottom rules (separate bot, its own card). Uses margin from pledged holdings, not cash. % = futures notional as a share of capital: 100% = Rs 20L notional on Rs 20L (about 1 lot).
buckets.test: Alone 2017-26: about 8%/yr at realistic fills, worst fall -12.5%; moves against stocks (correlation -0.1 to -0.2), so it cuts the book's worst fall from -21% to -16%. Bot stays in DRY RUN until you switch it.
